corpus is machine-generated. 1915 of 3209 records have the SEEDED workflow status. The harmonization rules are documented and tested, but a lexical match between a source label and an ontology label is a plausible grounding, not a verified one.

REVIEWED records carry a recorded workflow decision, including agent-assisted curation. These counts do not establish human review. Consult the attributed curation events on each record for its provenance.

Data downloads & LinkML schema

All HabitatMech records, category search indexes, semantic embedding coordinates, and schema definitions are openly available:

Semantic Embedding Map Data: text-map-source/points.json and text-map-source/manifest.json
YAML Corpus & Term Requests: data/habitats/ (3209 YAML records) and data/term_requests.tsv
Connected X-Mech Knowledge Bases: TaxonMech (reported microbial taxa), CommunityMech (ecological communities), CultureMech (growth media), TraitMech (environmental stress & physiological traits), and X-Mech Suite
